**Citations in order of use:**

**Step 1 — Confirming the 2018 FIFA World Cup was held**
1. Wikipedia, "2018 FIFA World Cup": https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2018_FIFA_World_Cup — confirms the tournament was held in Russia, 14 June – 15 July 2018.

**Step 2 — List of players named to national team squads**
2. Wikipedia, "2018 FIFA World Cup squads": https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2018_FIFA_World_Cup_squads — lists all 32 national team squads (736 players) registered for the tournament; used to identify all squad members.

**Step 3 — Identifying Ballon d'Or winners among squad members**
3. Wikipedia, "Ballon d'Or": https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ballon_d%27Or — full list of winners used to cross-reference squad members; confirms Messi, Ronaldo, Modrić (2018), Benzema (2022), Mbappé (2024), and no win for Griezmann in that category.

**Step 4 — Identifying UEFA Men's Player of the Year / Best Player in Europe / Club Footballer of the Year winners**
4. Wikipedia, "UEFA Men's Player of the Year Award": https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/UEFA_Men%27s_Player_of_the_Year_Award — includes all historical names (UEFA Club Footballer of the Year, UEFA Best Player in Europe Award, UEFA Men's Player of the Year); confirms Modrić (2017–18), Ronaldo (2007–08, 2013–14, 2015–16, 2016–17), Messi (2010–11, 2014–15), Benzema (2021–22), Griezmann (2015–16).

**Step 5 — Birthplaces**
5. Wikipedia, "Luka Modrić": https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Luka_Modri%C4%87 — born in Zadar, SR Croatia, Yugoslavia (now Croatia).
6. Wikipedia, "Cristiano Ronaldo": https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cristiano_Ronaldo — born in Funchal, Madeira, Portugal.
7. Wikipedia, "Lionel Messi": https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lionel_Messi — born in Rosario, Santa Fe, Argentina.
8. Wikipedia, "Karim Benzema": https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Karim_Benzema — born in Lyon, France.
9. Wikipedia, "Kylian Mbappé": https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kylian_Mbapp%C3%A9 — born in Paris, France.
10. Wikipedia, "Antoine Griezmann": https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Antoine_Griezmann — born in Mâcon, Saône-et-Loire, France.

**Step 6 — Populations of birthplaces**
11. Wikipedia, "Zadar": https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zadar — city population approximately 70,000 (2021 census).
12. Wikipedia, "Funchal": https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Funchal — urban area/city population approximately 105,000.
13. Wikipedia, "Rosario, Santa Fe": https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rosario,_Santa_Fe — city population approximately 1,193,000–1,200,000.
14. Wikipedia, "Lyon": https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lyon — commune population approximately 515,000 (2019).
15. Wikipedia, "Paris": https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paris — commune population approximately 2,100,000 (2020 estimate).
16. Wikipedia, "Mâcon": https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/M%C3%A2con — commune population approximately 34,000.
